style: Cinematic, dark and monumental, volumetric light, film grain, haze, embers. No new text, no logos, no emblems, no watermark, no identifiable faces - every figure in silhouette.

moments.title: Game 7 title, animated
moments.prompt: Start exactly on the first frame and keep every element of it in place: the arena, the two painted murals, the basket, the shaft of light, and the huge GAME 7 marquee letters hanging over the court. Over five seconds the camera pushes in slowly and steadily towards the letters. The letters come alive: their inner light surges brighter in a slow pulse, hot white-gold, throwing light down onto the hardwood; embers rise and drift around them; the haze in the shaft of light moves gently. The letters never change shape, spelling or position - GAME 7 stays perfectly legible the whole time. No new text appears anywhere.
